demand_assumption.notes: Low assumes 120 service days at 50% load; mid assumes 180 days at 55%; high assumes 200 days at 70%. All are derived from the sourced 344-seat, 5-shuttle/day pilot capacity and must be refreshed if current timetable differs.

fare_assumption.rationale: The 50 DA state-subsidized pilot fare is too low for a Navier premium/electric shuttle model; 500 DA is a transparent mid-case between local urban ride-hail/taxi leads and the 800 DA Oran–Mostaganem marine fare. Keep as an assumption, not a source fact.

source_register.evidence: Says Baleària ferries to Mostaganem dock at Route du Port, 15, Mostaganem; useful for BP minting only, not local fare/demand.

source_register.name: Algérie Ferries / ENTMV official site
source_register.evidence: Official ENTMV/Algérie Ferries site states its mission is maritime transport of passengers and vehicles, with online booking and ports/routes described through its booking platform.

source_register.name: Radio Algérienne / APS — Algiers bay pilot line
source_register.evidence: Pilot urban maritime passenger line opened between Port d'Alger/La Pêcherie and El Djamila/Aïn Bénian; 344-seat vessel, 50 DA fare, five daily shuttles, 30-minute voyage; planned expansion to Tamentfoust, Boumerdès, Tipaza, and Les Sablettes.

source_register.name: Port de Béjaïa PDF — Béjaïa–Alger urban maritime line
source_register.evidence: Port de Béjaïa PDF says an ENTMV urban maritime line links Port de Béjaïa to Port d'Alger in 4 hours using HSC vessels Seraïdi and Badji Mokhtar II; three weekly sailings; adult fare 1300 DA.

source_register.name: Radio Algérienne / APS — Oran–Mostaganem summer urban maritime service
source_register.evidence: ENTMV announced Oran–Mostaganem urban maritime services aboard Seraïdi through 30 September 2023, with services from 09:00 to 18:30; adult fare 800 DA, child fare 400 DA.

source_register.name: Ferryhopper Algeria 2026 routes
source_register.evidence: Lists Algeria ferry ports and schedules: Algiers, Béjaïa, Ghazaouet, Mostaganem, Oran; shows year-round/seasonal routes to/from Spain and France with durations/frequencies. Use for port existence and fare sanity, not Navier local demand.

source_register.name: GNV Algiers port page
source_register.evidence: Identifies Port of Algiers/Gare Maritime d’Alger at Via Angkor, Alger-Centre; describes central terminal access, bus/taxi/airport connectivity, and Sète–Algiers service.
